simple.meaning: Ard , the name of two Israelites
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַרְדְּ (H714) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.

definitions.short: Ard , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H714. Ard אַרְדְּ proper name, masculine Gen 46:21 son of Benjamin, but Num 26:40 grand son of Benjamin = אַדָּר 1Chr 8:3 .
